# Method IsOrigin

#### IsOrigin(ElementId)

##### Declaration

```

[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 8, 0, 0)]
bool IsOrigin(ElementId inElementId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  ElementId |  inElementId |  Identifier of the element to analyze.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- |
